# Weld Neck Flanges

> Engineered weld neck pipe flange supply across the full pressure spectrum from lightweight Class 125LW through API 6A and 6BX 20000 PSI. ASME B16.5 and B16.47, MSS SP-44 pipeline, AWWA C207 waterworks. Material range from A105 carbon through Hastelloy C276 nickel alloy.

## About

Weld Neck Flanges is a Houston-area specialist in tapered-hub forged and plate-cut weld neck flanges. The weld neck construction carries the grain orientation and hub geometry that high-pressure cyclic service demands, and it scales across the full pressure spectrum from lightweight low-pressure waterworks to 20000 PSI wellhead service.

## Pressure Classes

- Class 75, 125LW, 125, 175 lightweight waterworks
- ASME B16.5 Class 150, 300, 400, 600, 900, 1500, 2500
- ASME B16.47 Series A and B, Class 75 through 900
- API 6A 2M, 3M, 5M (6B series)
- API 6BX 10M, 15M, 20M, 25M
- AWWA C207 Class B, D, E, F
- MSS SP-44 pipeline pressure ratings

## Materials

- Carbon: A105, A350 LF2, A350 LF3, A516-70, A36, A694 F42 through F70
- Stainless: F304, F304L, F316, F316L, F321, F347, F347H, 904L, Alloy 20
- Chrome-moly alloy: F1, F5, F6, F9, F11, F12, F22, F91
- Hastelloy: B-2, C-276, C-22, G, X
- Inconel: 600, 601, 625, 718
- Incoloy: 800, 800H, 800HT, 825
- Monel: 400
- Duplex and super duplex: 2205, 2507
- Titanium: Grade 2, Grade 12
- Aluminum: 3003, 5083, 6061
- Copper alloys: 90/10 and 70/30 copper-nickel

## Standards

ASME B16.5, ASME B16.47 Series A and B, ASME B16.9, API 6A, API 6BX, API 605, MSS SP-44, AWWA C207, ANSI B16.1, DIN EN 1092-1, NACE MR0175
